raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary
- Mark Megatron Bridge 0.7.0 as the preferred Sphinx docs version on `r0.7.0`.
- Retain the 0.6.0 versioned link without the global latest label.

## Validation
- Parsed docs JSON, checked the single preferred version and release consistency, ran `git diff --check`, and passed all pre-commit hooks.

The separate Fern `latest.yml` remains the frozen 0.4.2 documentation; relabeling it as 0.7.0 would misrepresent its content.

No qualifying findings. The [version manifest](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/6d51d514f24e44f417d007fd925cdbb0bf015061/docs/versions1.json#L6-L15) makes 0.7.0 the sole preferred entry while preserving the 0.6.0 URL. It matches the Sphinx release metadata; leaving Fern’s frozen 0.4.2 content unchanged is appropriate.

Static inspection only; tests, rendered switcher behavior, and deployed URLs were not verified.

### Suggested test cases
- `test_docs_preferred_version` (proposed): parse the manifest and assert that exactly one entry is preferred, with version `0.7.0` and name `0.7.0 (latest) · 26.10`.
- `test_docs_version_links_preserved` (proposed): compare base and head version/URL pairs; assert they are unchanged, including nightly and 0.6.0, and that 0.6.0 is no longer preferred.
- No perf tests impacted.

> **Note:** formal approval is not available for this request, so this review is posted as a comment only.
